ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Minimal macro-level variance; ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels with a ratio exceeding 95% dark to 5% light values.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp, acute V-shaped median notch with deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge exhibits moderate-frequency serrations and micro-notches; left lobe trailing edge presents a more uniform, lower-amplitude topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curvature meeting convex leading edges to form sharply tapered, posteriorly swept tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular notch or loss of tissue on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Near-total uniform dark pigmentation (Type 1 or 2 fluke classification) across the visible ventral lobe surface.
